Located on<ref name="RC:HC" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], '''barrack block 5 Epsilon''' was a [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] complex within [[Fleet Support]], an installation built<ref name="RC:HC" /> by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="ERC" /> and utilized by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]]<ref name="RC:HC" /> in 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="ERC" /> Shortly after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] at the opening of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] [[Niner Skirata|RC-1309]] and [[Fi Skirata|RC-8015]] were billeted in the barrack block, which was otherwise deserted. The area was furnished with [[Bunk/Legends|bunks]] and lockers, the latter of which the [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] used to store their equipment.<ref name="RC:HC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Barrack block 5 Epsilon appeared in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact|Hard Contact]]'', the first novel in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' series written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="RC:HC" />
